_comment_this_file: CONTRACT. Template for the packaged MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B-NPU2/config.json. S1 copies this next to model.q4nx. The engine reads a FLATTENED config: LM_Config::_normalize_multi_modal() only lifts vocab_size out of text_config, so every text dimension MUST be hoisted to the top level here, exactly as Qwen3.5-0.8B-NPU2/config.json does.
_comment_text_tower: Hoisted verbatim from the upstream config.json text_config block. Identical to Qwen3.5-0.8B in every field except tie_word_embeddings and vocab_size, which is why the Qwen3.5-0.8B xclbins are reused unchanged.
_comment_rtp: Carried verbatim from Qwen3.5-0.8B-NPU2/config.json because we load that model's xclbins. Nothing at the current HEAD of either repo reads these keys, but RTP addresses are part of the kernel contract (AGENTS.md S7), so they must not be invented.
_comment_vision: S7b. vision_model_weight is what makes _normalize_multi_modal() set is_vlm, and with it the engine builds the vision tower (detail/minicpm_v_4_7_npu/image/) at load. It needs vision_weight.q4nx beside model.q4nx and vision_attn / vision_mm_a / vision_mm_b .xclbin (Qwen3.8's) in the model's xclbin folder, and throws naming whichever is missing. Keys use the engine naming convention (see Qwen3.5-0.8B-NPU2), not the upstream HuggingFace names. Values are MiniCPM's SigLIP tower, which shares nothing with Qwen3.5-VL's ViT and is dimensionally Qwen3.8-27B's.
